data.notes: Confirmed November 2026 listings for Cape Town are still limited this far out, with one major arena concert and one Western Cape electronic camping festival currently solidly verified.

events.title: Jill Scott - To Whom This May Concern 2026 Tour
events.summary: Jill Scott brings her To Whom This May Concern 2026 Tour to Cape Town for a confirmed 20:00 show at Grand Arena at GrandWest. The listing names Jill Scott as the performer for the Cape Town date.

events.title: Meidum: A Mountain Oasis 2026
events.summary: Meidum is a confirmed 27–29 November 2026 electronic camping festival at Pat Busch Mountain Reserve near Robertson, described by the organiser as two hours outside Cape Town. The event is built around a large pyramid-style dance stage with camping included in tickets.
